name: Spain
description: Follow Spain, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: ‘Do You Think if I Had a Job I Would Have Gone?’
changes.summary: Moroccan migrants described their despair at their economic future, explaining what propelled them across the border with Spain.

changes.title: In Ceuta, Far-Right Leaders Call on Spain to Expel Migrants
changes.summary: Far-right politicians and activists are flocking to the Spanish territory on the northern coast of Africa, fueling tensions there days after thousands of migrants entered the exclave.

changes.title: After Most Migrants Leave Ceuta, Exhausted Holdouts Find Shelter on Beach
changes.summary: Most of the people who surged into Spain on Thursday have since returned to Morocco. A small minority are holed up on a seafront, tired, hungry and vowing to stay.

changes.title: Far-Right Leaders Step Up Calls for Expelling Remaining Migrants in Ceuta
changes.summary: Spain’s leading far-right politician arrived in the territory on Sunday, fueling tensions there after thousands of migrants entered the exclave last week.

changes.title: Europe’s Far Right, Once Marginal, Now Sets Tone on Spain Migrant Crisis
changes.summary: Europe sheltered many refugees in 2015. Its hard-line reaction to a new crisis in Ceuta shows how, 11 years on, the far right has reshaped European attitudes.

changes.title: Spain to put containment fence on Ceuta's border with Morocco after frontier rush that killed 67
changes.summary: The death toll climbed to 67, including some who drowned and others who were killed in a stampede to cross a breakwater barrier, the Spanish government said Saturday.

changes.title: Death toll in Spain border crisis reaches 67 as tens of thousands cross back in to Morocco
changes.summary: The death toll in Spain's Ceuta border crisis with Morocco has climbed to 67. They included some who drowned and some who were killed in a stampede to cross a breakwater barrier. (Image credit: Antonio Sempere).

changes.title: Spain to put containment fence around Ceuta after migrants rush border
changes.summary: Most migrants who entered the tiny Spanish territory of Ceuta have been returned to Morocco, Spain's authorities said Saturday.

changes.title: Spain sends over 48,000 migrants back to Morocco from Ceuta; dozens dead
changes.summary: Spain's Ministry of the Interior said about 50,000 people entered the Spanish enclave since Thursday morning, with an estimated 48,300 back in Morocco by 6 p.m. Friday.

changes.title: 60,000 migrants poured into Spain from Morocco, Ceuta's president says, but many already left
changes.summary: According to the president of Ceuta, 60,000 migrants have flooded the small Spanish territory from Morocco since Thursday. Most voluntarily left the territory amid shortages of food, water and shelter, but thousands remained. Spain's prime minister called it an attack. Aiden Stretch reports from Ceuta, Spain.
